current_entrance_data_dependency: QuestDungeonService.AcceptOffer requires MissionEntranceCatalog.TryFindAt. Current selected MissionEntrances.json contains only PF540; no rolled spot uses PF540. With those current inputs, every generated offer is refused before acceptance persists.
input_semantics: YES/NO fields describe explicit destination candidate filtering; shared RNG consumption can create indirect output changes. Terminal identity is used for request ownership and return-objective retargeting, not pool selection.
membership_method: Exact playfield + compiled binary32 XYZ bits from decimal F literals. Complete placement identities are absent from current Spot model. All140 fail this exact join, so original intended placement identities are UNKNOWN; no nearest-neighbor rescue or invalidity claim is made.
new_catalog_role: Complete2242 placement identities and exact coordinates are content lookup authority; observed812 remains descriptive metadata and must not automatically become a complete eligibility pool.
random_weighting_definition: No numeric destination weight table or weighted-choice algorithm. Uniform index draws are modified by filtering and retry rejection; this does not prove uniform or independent retail selection.

rules.rule: Select exclusively from 140 static Spot objects; Spot has PF and XYZ plus two WorldPos integers but no complete placement identity.

rules.retail_authority: UNVERIFIED; September exact observations have no matched faction controls.
rules.rule: Known non-neutral city affiliation must equal character side; neutral city and unknown/wilderness terminals allow all sides.

rules.retail_authority: UNVERIFIED; side associations are not proven restrictions.
rules.rule: Terminal city affiliation replaces character side when known. Keep same-PF spots regardless of marker side; otherwise neutral terminal affiliation allows only neutral markers, other affiliations allow own side plus neutral. Priority fallback all can escape the side list.

rules.retail_authority: CONFLICTS_WITH_PROVEN_EVIDENCE for universal same-PF restriction at captured level2 PF655; other bands UNVERIFIED.
rules.rule: Levels <=40 take first nonempty same,near,ring,distance,side,all group. Levels41..80 take local,distance,side,all. Higher levels take distance,side,all. No expected-QL input.

rules.retail_authority: UNVERIFIED; no universal cross-playfield distance system is proven.
rules.rule: Same-PF distance is horizontal Euclidean distance from player position supplied by handler. Cross-PF distances are invented coarse travel tiers (800/1600 or1100/2400/4200/6500/9000; unknown3500). Above40 min=max(400,12*level-200); max=35*level+900. These distances are server policy, not reconstructed coordinate geometry.

rules.retail_authority: UNVERIFIED; observed frequencies are not weights or proof of independent draws.
rules.rule: Random.Next(candidate count) selects one Spot index uniformly for each attempt; no explicit numeric destination weights. Final distribution is modified by candidate filters and retry rejection. RNG is shared with type, shell and reward draws, so those draws can change the resulting RNG sequence without being destination eligibility inputs.

rules.retail_authority: UNVERIFIED anti-repeat distribution; strict prohibition would conflict with 2678 observed repeated-destination cohorts.
rules.rule: Retry up to48 times to avoid already selected Spot references. Above level40 additionally avoid any already selected playfield. On exhaustion draw without either restriction, so strict uniqueness is NOT enforced. This nonetheless introduces an anti-repeat bias unproven by current evidence.

weight_source: Uniform candidate-index RNG plus unproven candidate filtering and bounded anti-repeat policy; no measured retail weights.
